साउथ के गलियारों में छिड़ी है शादी की चर्चा, मेहमानों की लिस्ट है एकदम धाकड़!

म्यूजिक सेंसेशन अनिरुद्ध रविचंदर और काव्या मारन का मैरिज रिसेप्शन चर्चा का विषय बना हुआ है।
इस इवेंट के लिए सुपरस्टार महेश बाबू चेन्नई पहुंच चुके हैं।
खास बात ये है कि न्यूजीलैंड के स्टार क्रिकेटर केन विलियमसन को भी इवेंट में स्पॉट किया गया है।
अनिरुद्ध और काव्या के इस खास मौके पर फिल्मी दुनिया और खेल जगत के सितारे एक साथ दिखे।
महेश बाबू का चेन्नई पहुंचना सोशल मीडिया पर काफी वायरल हो रहा है।
केन विलियमसन की मौजूदगी ने फैंस को हैरान और खुश कर दिया है।

आपको इन दोनों की जोड़ी कैसी लगती है? कमेंट्स में बताओ! 😍✨🏏

ctx.title: Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran Marriage Reception: Mahesh Babu arrives in Chennai; NZ star Kane Williamson spotted
ctx.summary:
Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran are all set to host their wedding reception on November 21, 2026, following their wedding on November 11. Ahead of the celebrations, superstar Mahesh Babu and his wife, Namrata Shirodkar, were spotted arriving in Chennai. Former New Zealand cricket captain Kane Williamson was also seen arriving in the city for the occasion. 
 Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran Reception: Mahesh Babu arrives in Chennai with wife Namrata 
 According to several online reports, including Sun News Tamil,  Mahesh Babu  was spotted at Chennai airport as he arrived to attend Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran’s wedding reception. The actor was accompanied by his wife and former actress, Namrata Shirodkar. 
 Meanwhile, former New Zealand cricketer Kane Williamson was also spotted arriving at the airport for the celebrations. Other prominent guests, including Rajinikanth, Aditi Rao Hydari, Siddharth, Muthiah Muralitharan, Atlee and his wife Priya, Radikaa Sarathkumar, and several others, were also expected to attend the event. 
 Moreover, Thalapathy Vijay is reportedly expected to attend the reception, while other celebrities have sent their wishes to the couple through official messages. 
 Anirudh Ravichander and Sunrisers Hyderabad owner  Kavya Maran  recently tied the knot in a traditional self-respect marriage ceremony. Following the wedding, Anirudh also shared a series of pictures celebrating their union.
